description: REPORT a wrong scan result so NoData's detectors improve: files the scan flagged that are NOT actually sensitive (`not_sensitive`: relative paths or patterns from the scan), and kinds of data it MISSED (`missed`: {"phone": 2}). Send only what the user said — never guess on their behalf. Content-free: only kind labels and counts leave this machine (e.g. "not_sensitive:ID×2 · missed:phone×1"), never a value, a file name or free text. It does not change any file or any plan; to leave a file alone use nodata_plan with "keep".

missed.description: Kinds the scan did not catch, with how many the user saw: id, phone, email, card, iban, bank_account, name, address, birth_date, medical, plate, secret, amount, business_term, other.

not_sensitive.description: Relative paths (or patterns like "fixtures/**") whose findings are false alarms, as the scan listed them.

path.description: The folder or file that was scanned.

name: nodata_scan_feedback
title: Report a wrong scan result
